# Raw-Answer Report Quality Checklist

## Independence

- [ ] The exact source run and lineage are named.
- [ ] `genesia verify` and evidence integrity were checked.
- [ ] Existing synthesis, canonical reports, appendices and prior independent reports were
      excluded before analysis.
- [ ] No provider, Persona, prototype or code analysis pipeline was invoked.
- [ ] No canonical source artifact was edited.

## Complete answer review

- [ ] Every configured question is in the ledger.
- [ ] Every eligible original answer and reason was reviewed.
- [ ] Eligible and reviewed answer IDs reconcile.
- [ ] Invalid, missing, skipped, automation and `not_observed` rows are explicit.
- [ ] Candidate feedback remains attached to the correct candidate.

## Counting

- [ ] Structured choices come from structured values.
- [ ] Every thematic count has a reviewed supporting-ID set.
- [ ] Keyword matches were not used as final counts without review.
- [ ] Every count has a denominator.
- [ ] Counts are described only for this synthetic cohort.

## Evidence

- [ ] Claimed candidate/control exposure is present in episodes.
- [ ] Episode paths verify experience facts but do not replace answer meaning.
- [ ] Prototype and automation limits are not product defects.
- [ ] Untried, delayed, persistent or system-level behavior is not inferred.
- [ ] Counterevidence is represented when it changes interpretation.

## Client usefulness

- [ ] The first substantive paragraph answers the user's decision or question.
- [ ] Recommended actions appear before methodology and large tables.
- [ ] Every recommendation identifies Candidate A, Candidate B, cross-candidate, shared
      product surface or follow-up research.
- [ ] Candidate-specific strengths survive even when another candidate wins.
- [ ] Different controls or design actions are not collapsed into a generic theme.
- [ ] Findings use natural language rather than repeated framework labels.
- [ ] Evidence detail is available but does not obscure the main conclusion.
- [ ] Route, segment and question inventories appear after conclusions unless auditing is
      the user's primary request.

## Focus and segments

- [ ] The report follows the requested analytical direction.
- [ ] Only configured or explicitly requested attributes are used.
- [ ] Segment group sizes are visible when segment conclusions are reported.
- [ ] Small groups remain descriptive.
- [ ] No causal claim is inferred from age, region, occupation or another attribute.
- [ ] No-difference results are retained instead of forcing contrast.

## Recommendations

- [ ] Actions are concrete and supported.
- [ ] Product changes and research follow-up are distinct.
- [ ] Recommendations preserve validated strengths.
- [ ] Priority reflects decision value, not merely frequency.

## Privacy and delivery

- [ ] Output is private unless publication was authorized.
- [ ] Raw Persona IDs use stable aliases where needed.
- [ ] Unnecessary profile fields, screenshots and traces are omitted.
- [ ] The filename is new and clearly non-canonical.
- [ ] The source declaration states that existing conclusions were excluded.
- [ ] Delivery states that no Persona or configured provider was invoked.
